idea: route parse-attachment and sense decisions through whole-text semantic topography
mechanism: semanticTopographicSimilarity answers 'noun' 3 times in 4 against a balanced set, so it is a class-biased constant; always guessing noun scores the same 8/16
evidence: 8/16 = 50% on 16 PP-attachment minimal pairs, chance 50%. Largest margin in the set is a WRONG answer (brush 0.314 beats telescope 0.277)
unbindsIf: a per-class breakdown clears chance on BOTH attachment classes, not just the aggregate
